nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-ai-skills/2026-09-27 - obsidian [ses_f1d1f7010ffeMMXqgy117zIbta].md:L1353] A translated artifact is a defect rather than a courtesy because it breaks grep, breaks reviewer scanning, and silently diverges from the files it sits next to

nodes.label: The vault plan mirror is a byte copy and is never translated on the way in
nodes.norm_label: the vault plan mirror is a byte copy and is never translated on the way in
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-ai-skills/2026-09-27 - obsidian [ses_f1d1f7010ffeMMXqgy117zIbta].md:L1357] mergeFrontmatter copies the plan text unchanged and source_hash covers that whole text, so a translated mirror reads as stale on the next --check, blocks --execute with exit 3, and fails the daily drift timer
